about: Reviewed corrections to district names in the official district atlas (districts.geojson), applied by canonical_data.canonical_districts before polygons that share a name are merged. A polygon is renamed only when its current name is also carried by another polygon in the same city and an independent source places it in a district that already exists in the atlas under the corrected name.

corrections.evidence: Labelled العليا beside polygons 492 and 493 that carry the same name; the 910ths demographic map places its interior in السليمانية (polygons 380, 381). Checked 2026-10-27.
